scope: Synthetic native DrawingData submission and native RequestDraw enqueue in Unicorn; host manually invokes native draw on the queued request. No real queue execution, ownership, Matrix4, GPU paint, saved page or device behavior.
limitations: Host supplies initialized flag, empty completion list, synthetic bitmap methods, bitmap reference and allocation callbacks, context adapters, and no-op critical-section and condition-signal callbacks; the queued request is manually drained. This run also constructs an unused preliminary AsyncDrawingData before submission. Host runtime and transitive harness dependencies are not fully pinned.
